# LuxeMia

> LuxeMia is an online Indian ethnic-wear store offering sarees, lehengas, suits, menswear and jewelry. Tracked shipping is available to the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Australia, New Zealand, South Africa and Mauritius.

## Store information

- Website: https://luxemia.shop
- WhatsApp: +1-215-341-9990
- Email: hello@luxemia.shop
- Supported destinations: United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Australia, New Zealand, South Africa and Mauritius
- Current shipping rates and thresholds: https://luxemia.shop/shipping
- Fit and construction options vary by product and may include unstitched, semi-stitched, ready-to-wear or made-to-measure choices

## Important purchase information

- Processing time occurs before dispatch; carrier transit begins after the parcel is accepted by the carrier.
- The product page and selected variant are the source of truth for materials, included pieces, measurements, construction, price, availability and processing information.
- Checkout is the source of truth for the final available shipping service, converted amount and taxes collected by LuxeMia, if applicable.
- Except where applicable law provides otherwise, LuxeMia does not accept voluntary change-of-mind returns or exchanges. Follow the current returns policy for damage, defect, incorrect-item or missing-item claims.
- Contact LuxeMia before ordering for a fixed event date; an estimate is not a delivery guarantee unless confirmed in writing.

## Machine-readable discovery files

- Sitemap: https://luxemia.shop/sitemap.xml
- Google-compatible merchant feed: https://luxemia.shop/merchant-feed.xml
- Organic-ready OpenAI product export (pending approved-partner onboarding and registered SFTP delivery): https://luxemia.shop/openai-search-products.jsonl.gz
- Full canonical page inventory: https://luxemia.shop/llms-full.txt

The OpenAI-ready export is configured for organic product discovery only: search eligibility is enabled, checkout eligibility is disabled and paid-ads eligibility is explicitly disabled. The public file is not a submission or proof of ingestion; approved-partner onboarding and registered SFTP delivery remain required. Inclusion and ranking are not guaranteed.
